l-e-e5-b01-01.title: A na-eme comparative mgbe niile site n’ịgbakwunye -er?
l-e-e5-b01-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “a na-eme comparative mgbe niile site n’ịgbakwunye -er na njedebe adjective” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-e5-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: A na-eme comparative mgbe niile site n’ịgbakwunye -er na njedebe adjective. Chọta ntụnyere megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: E gbakwunyere -er na tall. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: E gbakwunyere -er na fast. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: E gbakwunyere -er na small. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s1.explain: Ụdị atụnyere nke good bụ better, ọ bụghị gooder. Ọ bụ ụdị atụnyere na-enweghị usoro ebe okwu dum na-agbanwe.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: Good na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ better kama gooder nke e gbakwunyere -er, ya mere nkwupụta na a na-agbakwunye -er mgbe niile adịghị mma.
l-e-e5-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Good → better anaghị agbakwunye -er, ma okwu ahụ n'onwe ya na-agbanwe, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e5-b01-04.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "use an before a word that starts with a vowel letter" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e5-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: Jiri an mgbe niile tupu okwu na-amalite site na mkpụrụedemede a, e, i, o, ma ọ bụ u. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-amalite site na e, ya mere e jiri an. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-amalite site na o, ya mere e jiri an. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-amalite site na a, ya mere e jiri an. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s1.explain: University na-amalite site na u, ma ụda na-amalite site na "yoo." Ụda mbụ bụ ụda mkpụrụedemede ndị na-abụghị ụdaume, ya mere a na-eji a.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụna na university na-amalite site na u, ọ nwere ụda "yoo," ya mere a na-eji a, ọ bụghị an, ma nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-e5-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: Okwu ụfọdụ, dị ka a university, na-eji a ọbụna na ha na-amalite site na mkpụrụedemede ụdaume, ya mere ọ bụghị an mgbe niile.

l-e-e5-b01-05.topic: Ahịrị okwu mmegide oge ugbu a
l-e-e5-b01-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "use don't in a present negative sentence" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).

l-e-e5-b04-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "A person who reads every day has many books at home" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e5-b04-05.material: Dana kwuru, 'Ming, onye na-agụ akwụkwọ kwa abalị, ga-enwerịrị ọtụtụ akwụkwọ n'ụlọ.' Ming kwuru, 'I borrow all my books from the library.'
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Ebe mmadụ na-agụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ụlọ.
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ụdị akwụkwọ mmadụ hụrụ n'anya enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị.
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ naanị ihe Dana kwuru. Ọ naghị agbaji echiche ahụ.
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Akwụkwọ e gbaziri n'ụlọ akwụkwọ akwụkwọ anaghị adị n'ụlọ. Ọbụlagodi na mmadụ na-agụ ọtụtụ, ị nweghị ike ikwu na ọ nwere ọtụtụ akwụkwọ.
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na akwụkwọ niile e gbaziri n'ụlọ akwụkwọ akwụkwọ, ọ nwere ike ịbụ na enweghị ọtụtụ akwụkwọ n'ụlọ, ya mere echiche Dana nwere ike ịbụ nke na-ezighi ezi.
l-e-e5-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: Ịgụ ọtụtụ na inwe akwụkwọ dị iche, ya mere Ming bụ ikpe na-emegide echiche Dana.

l-e-e5-b05-03.s.s1.explain: I think pụtara na ọ doghị anya. Ọbụlagodi na will, enwere ike igosipụta ịkọ ihe.

l-e-e5-b05-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ na-eyi coat, ihu igwe dị jụụ n'ụbọchị ahụ. Chọta ọnọdụ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị jụụ mgbe snow na-ada. Nke a bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s1.r.b: Anyị apụghị ịmata ma ọ dị jụụ. Ọ naghị agbaji nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s1.r.d: Ụbọchị ifufe nwere ike ịdị jụụ. Ọ naghị emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ikpe nke ịyi coat n'ụbọchị ọkụ, mgbe ahụ ịyi coat apụtaghị na ọ bụ ụbọchị jụụ.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s2.model.0: Onye na-eme ihe nwere ike iyi coat ọbụlagodi n'ụbọchị ọkụ, ya mere ịyi coat apụtaghị na ọ dị jụụ.
l-e-e5-b05-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ụbọchị ọkụ ma a na-eyi coat, ya mere ọ na-egosi na nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-e5-b06-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na okwu nwere more ma ọ bụ most bụ superlative bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e5-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: Every expression with more or most is a superlative. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ superlative nwere most. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ superlative nwere most. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ superlative nwere most. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s1.explain: More careful bụ comparative na-atụnyere ihe abụọ. Ihe niile nwere more abụghị superlative.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: More careful bụ comparative, ya mere ọbụlagodi na more, ọ bụghị superlative, ma nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e5-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: More na-eme comparatives, ya mere ikwu na ihe niile nwere more ma ọ bụ most bụ superlative ezighi ezi.

l-e-e5-b02-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu ha yiri ibe ha, ya mere e kewaghị ìgwè abụọ ahụ.

l-e-e5-b02-09.s.s1.o.d: Ma ahịrịokwu ahụ na-amalite na pool
l-e-e5-b02-09.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu ndị na-amalite na pool dị n’ìgwè abụọ ahụ, ya mere agwakọtara ha.

l-e-e5-b01-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu be-verb ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ, ma nwalee iwu ahụ n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.

l-e-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ihe atụ atọ niile na-eme will mkpụmkpụ ruo 'll, ya mere they will na-aghọkwa they'll.
l-e-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Pattern bụ otu, ịgbakwunye 'll mgbe onye na-eme ihe, ya mere ịkọ ihe bụ they'll.

l-e-e5-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Ngwaa na-ejedebe n'otu vowel dị mkpụmkpụ + otu consonant na-amịkọrịta consonant ikpeazụ ma gbakwunye ing.

l-e-e5-b06-15.title: Iwu na-ekewa too na either
l-e-e5-b06-15.goal: Chọta iwu too na either na-egosi na otu ọnọdụ metụtakwara onye ọzọ, site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ; kwuo ya ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e5-b06-15.material: I like pizza, and my friend likes pizza too. / I don’t like fish, and my friend doesn’t like fish either. Chọta iwu ahụ ma dejupụta oghere: I can’t swim, and my cousin can’t swim ___.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Also adabaghị ná njedebe ahịrịokwu ọjọọ.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: Very abụghị okwu na-egosi na otu ọnọdụ metụtakwara.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.r.c: A na-eji too n’ahịrịokwu nkwenye. N’ahịrịokwu ọjọọ dị n’ihe atụ ahụ, e ji either.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s1.explain: Jiri too ná njedebe ahịrịokwu nkwenye, jiri either ná njedebe ahịrịokwu ọjọọ. E nwere can’t, ya mere ọ bụ either.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ ndị ahụ, either dị na njedebe ahịrịokwu ọjọọ; ya mere jiri either mgbe can’t swim gasịrị.
l-e-e5-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu ọjọọ na-eji either, nke nkwenye na-ejikwa too; ya mere either dabara n’ahịrịokwu nwere can’t.

l-e-e5-b07-05.topic: Subject e jikọtara site na and
l-e-e5-b07-05.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke udi verb na-aga na subject e jikọtara site na and, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e5-b07-05.material: Ihe atụ: Mina plays. / Mina and Jun play. / The cat and the dog sleep. / My dad and I cook.
l-e-e5-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Chọta iwu ahụ ma jupụta oghere: My uncle and my aunt ___ in Busan.
l-e-e5-b07-05.s.s1.r.a: A na-eji is maka otu onye. E nwere abụọ, ya mere are ga-abịarịrị.
l-e-e5-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ihe abụọ e jikọtara site na and bụ plural, ya mere agbakwunyela -s.
l-e-e5-b07-05.s.s1.r.d: -ing naanị anaghị eme ahịrịokwu present tense.
l-e-e5-b07-05.s.s1.explain: Subject e jikọtara dị ka A na B bụ abụọ. Jiri verb n'enweghị -s na subject plural.

l-e-e5-b01-17.material: Aga m agụ peeji 12 kwa ụbọchị. Akwụkwọ ahụ nwere peeji 90. Tụọ ụbọchị ole ọ ga-ewe ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-agụ peeji 12 kwa ụbọchị.

l-e-e5-b01-17.s.s1.r.b: N’ime ụbọchị 15~20, ị ga-agụ ihe karịrị peeji 180. Atụmatụ ahụ dị elu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e5-b01-17.s.s1.r.d: N’ime ụbọchị 70~80, ị ga-agụ ihe karịrị peeji 800. Lelee ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ ya.

l-e-e5-b01-18.material: Ị na-amụta okwu Bekee 6 kwa ụbọchị. Ọ bụrụ na ị mụta ha kwa ụbọchị n’enweghị ịhapụ otu ụbọchị n’ime izu 4 (ụbọchị 28), tụọ ngụkọta okwu ole ọ ga-abụ.
l-e-e5-b01-18.s.s1.r.a: 6×7=42 bụ nke otu izu. Izu 4 ga-abụ ọtụtụ karịa.
l-e-e5-b01-18.s.s1.r.b: 250 ma ọ bụ karịa ga-apụta ịmụ ihe karịrị 9 kwa ụbọchị.

l-e-e5-b01-18.s.s1.explain: Ịtụ okwu 6 maka ụbọchị 30 na-enye okwu 180. Ụbọchị 28 pere mpe ntakịrị, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 170.

l-e-e5-b01-20.title: Ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu 40 ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ: ọ ga-ewe nkeji ole?

l-e-e5-b01-20.material: Ịgbanwe nkwupụta ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ na-ewe ihe dị ka sekọnd 30 maka ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla. Tụọ ogologo oge ọ ga-ewe iji gbanwee ahịrịokwu 40 niile.

l-e-e5-b01-20.s.s1.explain: Sekọnd 30 ugboro abụọ na-eme nkeji 1; ya mere ahịrịokwu 2 na-ewe nkeji 1. Ahịrịokwu 40 ga-ewe nkeji 20.
l-e-e5-b01-20.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu 2 na-ewe nkeji 1, 40 bụkwa okpukpu 20 nke 2; ya mere ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 20.

l-e-e5-b02-16.title: Okwu ole dị n’akụkọ peeji 11 ahụ?

l-e-e5-b02-16.material: Otu peeji nke akwụkwọ foto nwere ihe dị ka okwu 48. Akụkọ ahụ dị ogologo peeji 11. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu dị n’akụkọ ahụ dum.
l-e-e5-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ dị n’ime peeji abụọ. O zughi maka peeji 11.

l-e-e5-b02-16.s.s1.explain: Ịtụ 48 ka ọ bụrụ 50 na-enye 50×11=550. 48 pere mpe ntakịrị karịa 50, ya mere ọ dị n’etiti 500 na 550.
l-e-e5-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Ịtụ 48 ka ọ bụrụ 50 na-enye ihe dị ka 550 maka peeji 11, ọnụ ọgụgụ n’ezie dị ntakịrị ala, ya mere 500 ruo 550.
l-e-e5-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Otu peeji nwere ihe dị ka okwu 50, ya mere peeji 10 nwere 500, peeji 11 nwekwara ntakịrị karịa 500; ya mere ọ bụ 500 ruo 550.

l-e-e5-b02-17.s.s1.r.b: N’ime nkeji 8, ị ga-aga ihe dị ka mita 500. Nke ahụ ezughị kilomita 1.2.

l-e-e5-b02-17.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị gaa kilomita 4 n’ime awa 1, kilomita 1 na-ewe nkeji 15. Kilomita 1.2 na-ewe ntakịrị karịa nkeji 15, ya mere ọ bụ nkeji 15 ruo 20.
l-e-e5-b02-17.s.s2.model.0: Kilomita 4 na-ewe nkeji 60; ya mere kilomita 1 na-ewe nkeji 15. Kilomita 1.2 na-ewe ntakịrị karịa nke ahụ, ya bụ nkeji 15 ruo 20.

l-e-e5-b03-16.title: Ugboro ole elephant dị arọ karịa nwamba?
l-e-e5-b03-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọdịiche arọ n'etiti elephant na nwamba iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e5-b03-16.material: Elephant na-arọ ihe dị ka 5000 kg. Nwamba na-arọ ihe dị ka 4 kg. Tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ugboro ole elephant dị arọ karịa nwamba.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Ugboro 150 nke 4 kg bụ 600 kg. Nke ahụ dị ala karịa 5000 kg.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s1.o.b: ihe dị ka ugboro 10000 ma ọ bụ karịa
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s1.r.b: Ugboro 10000 nke 4 kg bụ 40000 kg. Nke ahụ dị arọ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s1.r.d: Ugboro 15 nke 4 kg bụ 60 kg. Enyí dị arọ karịa nke ukwuu.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s1.explain: Ugboro 1000 nke 4 kg bụ 4000 kg. 5000 kg dị ntakịrị karịa nke ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ ugboro 1000-1500.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: 4×1000=4000, 4×1500=6000; ya mere 5000 dị n’etiti ha. Nke ahụ na-eme ya ihe dị ka ugboro 1000-1500.
l-e-e5-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: 5000 e kewara na 4 dị ntakịrị karịa 1000, ya mere enyí dị ihe dị ka ugboro 1000-1500 arọ karịa pusi.

l-e-e5-b03-17.goal: Tụọ izu ole ọ ga-ewe iji chekwaa dollar 40 ka i kpebie oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e5-b03-17.material: Aga m echekwa dollar 3 kwa izu. Egwuregwu na-efu dollar 40. Tụọ izu ole ị ga-echekwa iji zụta ya.

l-e-e5-b03-17.s.s1.r.b: N’ime izu 4-5, ị nwere ike ichekwa naanị dollar 12-15.
l-e-e5-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: Izu 130 ga-abụ dollar 390. Lelee ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ ya.
l-e-e5-b03-17.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị chekwaa dollar 3 kwa izu, izu 13 bụ dollar 39, izu 14 bụ dollar 42. Dollar 40 dị n’etiti ha, ya mere ọ bụ izu 13-14.
l-e-e5-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: 3×13=39 na 3×14=42; dollar 40 dị n’etiti izu 13 na 14. Nke ahụ na-eme izu 13-14 ka o daba adaba.
l-e-e5-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Dollar 40 e kewara na 3 dị n’etiti 13 na 14, ya mere ị chọrọ izu 13-14.

l-e-e5-b03-18.goal: Tụọ ụbọchị ole ọ ga-ewe iji mụta mkpụrụedemede Bekee niile ka i kpebie oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e5-b03-18.material: Mkpụrụedemede Bekee nwere mkpụrụedemede 26. Ọ bụrụ na ị mụta mkpụrụedemede 4 kwa ụbọchị, tụọ ụbọchị ole ọ ga-ewe iji mụta ha niile.
l-e-e5-b03-18.s.s1.r.a: N’ime ụbọchị 3, ị ga-amụta naanị mkpụrụedemede 12. Nke ahụ erughị 26.
l-e-e5-b03-18.s.s1.r.b: N’ime ụbọchị 20, ọ ga-abụ mkpụrụedemede 80. Atụmatụ ahụ dị elu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e5-b03-18.s.s1.r.c: N’ime ụbọchị 100, ọ ga-abụ mkpụrụedemede 400. Oge ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu.

l-e-e5-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: 4×6=24 na 4×7=28; ya mere mkpụrụedemede 26 dị n’etiti ụbọchị 6 na 7. Nke ahụ na-eme ya ụbọchị 6-7.

l-e-e5-b03-19.title: Okwu ole dị n’otu peeji?
l-e-e5-b03-19.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu dị n’otu peeji akwụkwọ ka i kpebie oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e5-b03-19.material: Peeji akwụkwọ na-enweghị foto nwere ahịrị 24, ahịrị nke ọ bụla nwekwara ihe dị ka okwu 9. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu dị n’otu peeji.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakwụnyere ya dịka 24+9. Ị ga-amụba ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrị na ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka ahịrị 12. Ahịrị dị 24.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị nke ọ bụla ga-achọ ihe karịrị okwu 80. Nke ahụ karịrị akarị.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s1.explain: Ịtụ 24 ka ọ bụrụ 25 na 9 ka ọ bụrụ 10 na-enye ihe dị ka 25×9=225. Ngụkọta kpọmkwem bụ 216, ya mere ọ bụ okwu 200-220.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị nke ọ bụla nwere ihe dị ka okwu 9, ahịrị dịkwa 24, ya mere 9×24=216. Nke ahụ bụ okwu 200-220.
l-e-e5-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma ị tụgharịa ahịrị 24 ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị 25, 25×9=225; ya mere ọ dị ntakịrị karịa okwu 200, ihe dị ka 220.

l-e-e5-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: A gụrụ 20% dịka ahịrịokwu 20. Pasent pụtara ụfọdụ n’ime 100.

l-e-e5-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ buru ibu nke ukwuu. 12 × 8 dị gburugburu 100.
l-e-e5-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere ọnụọgụ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. Nwaa ịtụ anya 12 × 8.
l-e-e5-b04-16.s.s1.explain: 12 × 8 = 96, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka 100 n'peeji.
l-e-e5-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: 12 × 8 bụ 96, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka 100 n'peeji.
l-e-e5-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: E nwere ihe dị ka 8 n'ahịrị ọ bụla ma ahịrị 12, ya mere ọ dị nso na 100.

l-e-e5-b04-17.title: Ụbọchị ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji mezue akwụkwọ ahụ?
l-e-e5-b04-17.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ ụbọchị iji mezue ịgụ akwụkwọ akụkọ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e5-b04-17.material: Akwụkwọ akụkọ ahụ nwere peeji 120. Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ peeji 15 kwa ụbọchị, tụọ anya ụbọchị ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji mezue akwụkwọ ahụ.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu. N'ụbọchị 2, ị na-agụ naanị peeji 30.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. N'ụbọchị 20, ị na-agụ peeji 300.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. N'ụbọchị 80, ị na-agụ peeji 1200.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Peeji 15 maka ụbọchị 8 bụ peeji 120. Ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 8.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: Peeji 15 maka ụbọchị 8 bụ peeji 120, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ụbọchị 8.
l-e-e5-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: 120 kewara site na 15 bụ 8, ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 8.

l-e-e5-b04-18.title: Ole ka ha ga-agba ọsọ ngwa ngwa?
l-e-e5-b04-18.goal: Tụọ anya ọdịiche dị n'oge ịgba ọsọ mmadụ abụọ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e5-b04-18.material: Pat na-agba 100 m n'ihe dị ka sekọnd 16, ma Lee na-agba ya n'ihe dị ka sekọnd 14. Lee dị ọsọ karịa Pat. Tụọ anya ọdịiche dị n'oge.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka sekọnd ole ka Lee dị ọsọ karịa Pat?
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ tụrụ anya ọdịiche dị ka nke pere mpe nke ukwuu.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s1.r.c: Ọ tụrụ anya ọdịiche ka ọ dị oge iri karịa. Lelee 16 − 14.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gbakwunyere oge abụọ ahụ. Chọta ọdịiche site n'iwepụ.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s1.explain: 16 − 14 = 2, ya mere Lee dị ọsọ karịa site n'ihe dị ka sekọnd 2. Oge pere mpe, ọ dị ọsọ karị.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: 16 − 14 bụ 2, ya mere Lee dị ọsọ karịa site n'ihe dị ka sekọnd 2.
l-e-e5-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Ị na-achọta ọdịiche site n'iwepụ oge abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka sekọnd 2.

l-e-e5-b04-19.title: Awa ole ka njem ije echi ga-ewe?
l-e-e5-b04-19.goal: Tụọ anya oge a ga-ejegharị echi, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e5-b04-19.material: Anyị ga-eje njem ije 12 km echi. Anyị na-ejegharị ihe dị ka 4 km n'awa otu. Tụọ anya oge ọ na-ewe.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu. N'awa 1, ị na-aga naanị 4 km.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. N'awa 8, ị na-aga 32 km.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọ mụbara 12 na 4. Ị chọrọ ịkewa.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s1.explain: 12 ÷ 4 = 3, ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka awa 3.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: 12 ÷ 4 bụ 3, ya mere ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka awa 3.
l-e-e5-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: Na 4 km n'awa otu, awa atọ bụ 12 km, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka awa 3.

l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ igbe achọrọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e5-b04-20.title: Igbe akwụkwọ ndetu ole ka a chọrọ?
l-e-e5-b04-20.goal: Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ igbe iji jide akwụkwọ ndetu, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e5-b04-20.material: Klaasị nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ 28, ma e nyere nwa akwụkwọ ọ bụla otu akwụkwọ ndetu. Igbe nwere ike ijide akwụkwọ ndetu 10. Tụọ anya ọnụọgụ igbe achọrọ.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s1.r.a: E nwere naanị akwụkwọ ndetu 20, nke zuru ezu abụghị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ 28.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s1.r.b: Ọ tụlebeghị na igbe na-ejide akwụkwọ ndetu 10.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere mgbagha n'ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ ndetu dị n'igbe na ọnụọgụ igbe.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s1.explain: Akwụkwọ ndetu 28 karịrị 20 ma pere mpe karịa 30. Igbe 3 bụ akwụkwọ ndetu 30, ya mere ọ naghị adị ntakịrị.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: 28 buru ibu karịa 20, ya mere igbe 2 ezughị, ma igbe 3 bụ akwụkwọ ndetu 30, nke zuru ezu.
l-e-e5-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: Igbe na-ejide akwụkwọ ndetu 10, ya mere ị chọrọ igbe 3 iji jide akwụkwọ ndetu 28.

l-e-e5-b05-16.title: Oge e jiri gụọ akwụkwọ Bekee otu ọnwa
l-e-e5-b05-16.goal: Tụọ oge e jiri gụọ akwụkwọ Bekee otu ọnwa, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e5-b05-16.material: Ị na-agụ akwụkwọ Bekee nkeji 20 kwa ụbọchị otu ọnwa (ụbọchị 30). Awa ole ka nke ahụ bụ n'ozuzu?
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị ntakịrị nke ukwuu. Ị na-agụ nkeji 20 ọbụna n'otu ụbọchị.
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. Awa 100 karịrị awa 3 kwa ụbọchị.
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s1.r.d: Agbanwebeghị nkeji 600 ka ọ bụrụ awa.
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 20 × ụbọchị 30 = nkeji 600, ma nkeji 60 bụ awa 1, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka awa 10.
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: 20 × 30 bụ nkeji 600, ya mere ịkewa site na 60 na-enye ihe dị ka awa 10.
l-e-e5-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: N'ụbọchị 3, a na-agụ nkeji 20 ugboro 3, nke bụ awa 1, ya mere n'ụbọchị 30 ọ bụ ihe dị ka awa 10.

l-e-e5-b05-19.material: E nwere ebe a na-anọdụ 4 n'ogige. Mmadụ 6 pụrụ ịnọdụ n'otu ebe a na-anọdụ. Tụọ ole mmadụ pụrụ ịnọdụ n'ozuzu.
l-e-e5-b05-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ndị pụrụ ịnọdụ kwesịrị ekwesị?

l-e-e5-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. 4 × 6 bụ 24.
l-e-e5-b05-19.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ọnụọgụ buru ibu nke ukwuu. Lelee 4 × 6.
l-e-e5-b05-19.s.s1.explain: Mmadụ 6 n'ebe a na-anọdụ 4 nke ọ bụla bụ 6 × 4 = mmadụ 24.

l-e-e5-b05-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. 5 × 8 bụ 40.
l-e-e5-b05-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu. 5 × 8 bụ 40.

l-e-e5-b06-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mkpirikpi nke ukwuu. Ọ bụ naanị sekọnd 12 maka okwu nke ọ bụla.
l-e-e5-b06-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. Ọ karịrị nkeji 2 maka okwu nke ọ bụla.

l-e-e5-b06-16.s.s1.explain: 25 × 40 bụ sekọnd 1000. Sekọnd 60 bụ nkeji 1, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 15 ruo 17.

l-e-e5-b06-17.s.s1.prompt: Akpa A dị ọnụ karịa akpa B ihe dị ka ole?
l-e-e5-b06-17.s.s1.r.a: Ị tụrụ ọdịiche ahụ ka ọ pere mpe karịa. Gbalịa 20−12.
l-e-e5-b06-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ naanị ọnụ ahịa akpa A. A na-achọta ọdịiche site n’iwepụ otu n’ime nke ọzọ.
l-e-e5-b06-17.s.s1.r.d: A gbakwụnyere ọnụ ahịa abụọ ahụ. A na-achọta ọdịiche site n’iwepụ.
l-e-e5-b06-17.s.s1.explain: 19.90 dị ihe dị ka 20, 12.10 dịkwa ihe dị ka 12; ya mere 20−12=8.

l-e-e5-b06-18.material: Batrị ekwentị ahụ fọdụrụ 60%. Ọ na-ebelata ihe dị ka 10% kwa awa. Ekwentị m ga-arụ ọrụ ihe dị ka awa ___. Tụọ ogologo oge a pụrụ iji ya.
l-e-e5-b06-18.s.s1.prompt: Oge ole ka mmadụ nwere ike iji ya bụ nke ezi uche dị na ya?

l-e-e5-b06-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu. N’ime awa 10, ọ ga-ebelata 100%.

l-e-e5-b01-24.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ eziokwu a na-ahụkarị bụ eziokwu.
l-e-e5-b01-24.s.s1.o.c: ③ Jun nyere ya mmiri karịrị oke
l-e-e5-b01-24.s.s1.o.d: ④ O wuru n'ihi mmiri karịrị oke
l-e-e5-b01-24.s.s1.r.d: ④ na-esite n'③. Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru.

l-e-e5-b01-25.title: Sam don't like tea… Ebe kedu ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-e5-b01-25.topic: Ime ihe na-adịghị mma nke ugbu a
l-e-e5-b01-25.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, maka ime ahịrịokwu na-adịghị mma banyere Sam. Chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma rụzie ya.
l-e-e5-b01-25.material: Ihe ọ pụtara bụ 'Sam does not like tea.' Ngwọta: ① Ọ bụ okwu ugbu a ma na-adịghị mma ② Onye na-eme ihe Sam bụ otu onye ③ Jiri don't n'ahịrịokwu na-adịghị mma ④ Nsonaazụ: Sam don't like tea.
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọ bụ okwu ugbu a ma na-adịghị mma
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.o.b: ② Onye na-eme ihe Sam bụ otu onye
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.r.b: Sam bụ otu onye, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.o.c: ③ Jiri don't n'ahịrịokwu na-adịghị mma
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.o.d: ④ Nsonaazụ: Sam don't like tea.
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s1.explain: Mgbe onye na-eme ihe bụ otu onye (onye nke 3 otu), jiri doesn't n'ahịrịokwu na-adịghị mma nke ugbu a. ③ na-ezighị ezi.
l-e-e5-b01-25.s.s2.model.0: Maka Sam, onye bụ otu onye, ị ghaghị iji doesn't, ọ bụghị don't, ya mere ③ na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-e5-b02-21.title: the most big box, ebe njehie dị?
l-e-e5-b02-21.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ime ahịrịokwu banyere igbe kacha ibu, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'usoro, wee chọta ebe ọ buru ụzọ gabigara ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b02-21.material: Ihe pụtara bụ “Nke a bụ igbe kacha ibu.” Nzọụkwụ: ① Kwuo nke kacha ibu n'etiti ọtụtụ igbe ② Jiri superlative ③ Tinye most tupu big ④ Nsonaazụ: This is the most big box.
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Kwuo nke kacha ibu n'etiti ọtụtụ
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s1.r.b: Anyị na-ekwu nke kacha ibu, ya mere superlative ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Nsonaazụ: the most big box
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ na-ezighị ezi nke nzọụkwụ gara aga. Ọ bụghị ebe ọ buru ụzọ gabigara ụzọ.
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s1.explain: big bụ adjective dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere gbakwunye -est kama most. Mee consonant ikpeazụ okpukpu abụọ ma ọ ghọọ biggest.
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s2.model.0: N'③, etinyere most tupu adjective dị mkpụmkpụ big, mana a ga-agbakwunye -est, ya mere ọ ezighị ezi. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ the biggest box.
l-e-e5-b02-21.s.s2.model.1: big dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere mee g okpukpu abụọ ma ọ ghọọ biggest; ọ bụrụ na ị dozie ③, ọ ghọọ This is the biggest box.

l-e-e5-b02-25.title: Jun is writeing…, ebe njehie dị?
l-e-e5-b02-25.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ime ahịrịokwu na-ekwu na Jun na-ede akwụkwọ ozi, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'usoro, wee chọta ebe ọ buru ụzọ gabigara ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b02-25.material: Ihe pụtara bụ “Jun na-ede akwụkwọ ozi.” Nzọụkwụ: ① Ọ bụ ihe na-eme ugbu a ② Jiri is + verb-ing ③ Gbakwunye ing n'write naanị ④ Nsonaazụ: Jun is writeing a letter.
l-e-e5-b02-25.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọ bụ ihe na-eme ugbu a
l-e-e5-b02-25.s.s1.r.b: Ihe na-eme ugbu a na-eji is + -ing, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b02-25.s.s1.explain: Maka verbs na-agwụ na e, hichapụ e ma gbakwunye ing. write na-aghọ writing.
l-e-e5-b02-25.s.s2.model.0: N'③, agbakwunyere ing n'enweghị ihichapụ e nke write, ya mere ọ ezighị ezi. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ writing.
l-e-e5-b02-25.s.s2.model.1: Maka verbs na-agwụ na e, hichapụ e ma gbakwunye ing, ya mere ọ bụrụ na ị dozie ③, ọ ghọọ Jun is writing a letter.

l-e-e5-b03-21.title: heavier then yours, ebee ka ihe si mehie?
l-e-e5-b03-21.goal: Soro usoro azịza e si dee ahịrịokwu na-ekwu na akpa m dị arọ karịa nke gị, chọta ebe mbụ o si mehie ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b03-21.material: Ihe ọ pụtara bụ “Akpa m dị arọ karịa nke gị.” Azịza: ① Tụnyere ịdị arọ akpa abụọ ahụ ② Comparative nke heavy bụ heavier ③ Dee “than” nke pụtara “karịa” dịka then ④ Emechara: My bag is heavier then yours.

l-e-e5-b03-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Comparative nke heavy bụ heavier
l-e-e5-b03-21.s.s1.r.b: Ee, ị na-agbanwe y ka ọ bụrụ i ma tinye er.
l-e-e5-b03-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Dee “than” nke pụtara “karịa” dịka then
l-e-e5-b03-21.s.s1.explain: “Karịa” bụ than. then bụ okwu ọzọ pụtara “n’oge ahụ” ma ọ bụ “mgbe ahụ”.

l-e-e5-b03-22.title: Jun ọ ga-anọ oge n’azụ ruo klas?
l-e-e5-b03-22.goal: Soro usoro azịza iji chọpụta ma Jun ọ ga-eru klaasị n’oge, chọta ebe mbụ o si mehie ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b03-22.material: Jun ga-eji ụkwụ gaa klaasị. Klas na-amalite n’elekere 9, njem ahụ na-ewe nkeji 15. Jun hapụrụ ụlọ na 8:50. Azịza: ① Klas na-amalite na 9 ② Njem ahụ na-ewe nkeji 15 ③ Ọ bụrụ na Jun hapụ na 8:50, ọ ga-eru nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gasịrị ④ Ya mere Jun agaghị anọ n’azụ.
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s1.o.c: ③ Jun ga-eru nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gasịrị
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s1.r.c: 8:50 tinyere nkeji 15 bụ nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gasịrị, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ya mere Jun agaghị anọ n’azụ
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s1.explain: Nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gachara bụ mgbe 9 gafere, mgbe klas malitere. ③ ziri ezi, ma nkwubi okwu ④ ezighị ezi.
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s2.model.0: Nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gachara bụ mgbe 9 gafere; ya mere nkwubi okwu ④ na Jun agaghị anọ n’azụ ezighị ezi. Dozie ya ka ọ kwuo na Jun ga-abịaghị n’oge.
l-e-e5-b03-22.s.s2.model.1: Na ③, a gbakọrọ oge ọ ga-eru dịka nkeji 5 mgbe 9 gasịrị; ya mere ④ kwesịrị ikwu na Jun ga-abịaghị n’oge nkeji 5.

l-e-e5-b05-22.material: Ngwọta: ① Ọ na-ekwu na ha agaghị ewu mmiri echi ② Ọ bụ ahịrịokwu be going to ③ Maka negative, tinye don't tupu going ④ We don't going to swim tomorrow. Chọta nzọụkwụ mbụ na-agabiga ụzọ.

l-e-e5-b05-24.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ntụle e sitere n'ederede (ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) n'usoro, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b05-24.material: Ederede: Ari put on a raincoat and took an umbrella. Then Ari went out. Ntụle: ① Ọ dị ka mmiri ga-ezo ② Ari chere na a chọrọ umbrella ③ Ari nọ n'ụzọ gaa ụlọ akwụkwọ ④ Ụlọ akwụkwọ dị anya
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ntụle mbụ nke na-enweghị ntọala.

l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.r.a: Raincoat na umbrella bụ ihe ngosi maka ①. Ọ nwere ntọala.
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.o.b: ② Ari chere na a chọrọ umbrella
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.r.b: Iburu umbrella bụkwa ihe ngosi maka ②.
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ari nọ n'ụzọ gaa ụlọ akwụkwọ
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.r.d: ④ enweghịkwa ntọala, mana ọ na-esochi ③.
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s1.explain: Ederede ahụ ekwughị ụlọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla. Ihe ngosi niile na-agwa anyị bụ na ọ dị ka mmiri ga-ezo.
l-e-e5-b05-24.s.s2.model.0: ③ enweghị ntọala n'ihi na ederede ahụ ekwughị ihe ọ bụla banyere ụlọ akwụkwọ. Naanị ihe ngosi bụ raincoat na umbrella.

l-e-e5-b06-24.s.s1.r.a: ① dabara na First. Ọ bụghị mmejọ mbụ.
l-e-e5-b06-24.s.s1.o.b: ② Nke abụọ: riri achịcha ahụ
l-e-e5-b06-24.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nke atọ: mere achịcha ahụ n’ekwú
l-e-e5-b06-24.s.s1.o.d: ④ Mere ya n’ekwú mgbe e risịrị ya

l-e-e5-b07-01.title: "the youngest in the three children"? Ilele
l-e-e5-b07-01.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ime ahịrịokwu superlative (ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) n'usoro, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b07-01.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta na-atụnyere afọ nke ụmụaka atọ, Ana, Bo, na Cy. 1) Ịtụnyere atọ, ya mere ọ bụ superlative. 2) young na-aghọ the youngest. 3) Jiri in tupu three. 4) Ana is the youngest in the three children.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s1.o.a: 1) Ịtụnyere atọ, ya mere ọ bụ superlative
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ị na-atụnyere atọ ma ọ bụ karịa, superlative ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s1.r.b: Superlative nke young bụ the youngest, nke ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu ahụ bu naanị njehie sitere n'nzọụkwụ 3.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s1.explain: Jiri of tupu otu ìgwè e kpebiri nke atọ (ụmụaka atọ ahụ). A na-eji in na ìgwè ma ọ bụ ebe dị ka klas ma ọ bụ ezinụlọ.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s2.model.0: Nzọụkwụ 3 ezighị ezi. Ụmụaka atọ ahụ bụ otu ìgwè e kpebiri nke atọ, ya mere jiri of, ma ọ na-aghọ the youngest of the three children.
l-e-e5-b07-01.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji in tupu ìgwè ma ọ bụ ebe dị ka klas, ya mere tupu okwu na-atụ aka n'ụmụaka atọ ahụ, dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ of.

l-e-e5-b07-09.title: "The twins don't has a cat"? Ilele
l-e-e5-b07-09.topic: Ime ahịrịokwu negative site na have
l-e-e5-b07-09.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu have ka ọ bụrụ ahịrịokwu negative (ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) n'usoro, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-e-e5-b07-09.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta nke gbanwere The twins have a cat. ka ọ bụrụ ahịrịokwu negative. 1) Subject The twins bụ abụọ. 2) Ebe ọ bụ abụọ, jiri don't. 3) Gbanwee have mgbe don't ka ọ bụrụ has. 4) The twins don't has a cat.
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s1.r.a: twins pụtara abụọ, ya mere plural ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s1.o.b: 2) Ebe ọ bụ abụọ, jiri don't
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s1.r.b: Maka subject plural, don't ziri ezi n'ahịrịokwu negative present tense.
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s1.o.c: 3) Gbanwee have mgbe don't ka ọ bụrụ has
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s1.explain: Mgbe don't bịa udi mbụ nke verb. Hapụ have dị ka ọ dị ma kwuo The twins don't have a cat.
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s2.model.0: Nzọụkwụ 3 ezighị ezi. Ebe don't dịworo, verb mgbe ya ga-abụrịrị udi mbụ have, ya mere ekwesịghị ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ has.
l-e-e5-b07-09.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji udi mbụ nke verb mgbe don't, ya mere dozie has ka ọ bụrụ have, ma ọ na-aghọ The twins don't have a cat.

l-e-e5-b03-26.goal: Degharịa “This bag is not as heavy as that bag.” n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese, nkọwa), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-e5-b03-26.material: This bag is not as heavy as that bag. Ị chọrọ iji that bag dịka isiokwu kwuo otu ihe ahụ.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s1.r.a: A gbanwere usoro akpa ndị ahụ. Ihe ọ pụtara na-aghọ ihe megidere ya.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s1.r.c: Ọ ga-apụta na akpa ahụ dị mfe karịa. Ihe mbụ pụtara bụ na akpa ahụ dị arọ karịa.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s1.r.d: not adịghị, ya mere ọ ga-apụta na ịdị arọ ha hà nhata.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na akpa a adịghị arọ ka akpa ahụ, mgbe ahụ akpa ahụ dị arọ karịa. Mgbe ị gbanwere isiokwu, jiri heavier than.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọ pụtara na akpa a dị mfe karịa akpa ahụ; ya mere akpa ahụ dị arọ karịa, “That bag is heavier than this bag.” nwekwara otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-e5-b03-26.s.s2.model.1: not as heavy as pụtara ịdị arọ pere mpe; ya mere mgbe isiokwu ghọrọ that bag, ọ na-aghọ heavier than.

l-e-e5-b07-08.title: Ịgbanwe Be on time ka ọ bụrụ mmachibido
l-e-e5-b07-08.goal: Dee ọzọ Be on time. dị ka mmachibido n'udi ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, foto, okwu) ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe pụtara ji bụrụ otu.
l-e-e5-b07-08.material: Ịchọrọ idee ọzọ iwu klas "Be on time." dị ka mmachibido, "Don't be late," ka ọ nwee otu ihe pụtara.
l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu e gbanwere nke ọma ka ọ nwee otu ihe pụtara.

l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s1.r.c: Iji machibido ihe, tinye Don't, ọ bụghị Not, n'ihu kpamkpam.
l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe Don't bịa udi mbụ be, ọ bụghị are.
l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Iwu negative bụ Don't + udi mbụ. A na-ede verb be dịkwa ka Don't be.
l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: Don't be late ziri ezi n'ihi na ọ pụtara otu ihe dị ka Be on time: ebula ọ gafere oge.
l-e-e5-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: Iji machibido ihe, jiri udi mbụ be mgbe Don't, ya mere kwuo ya dị ka Don't be late.

l-e-e5-b03-33.s.s1.o.b: A: Contraction na-ada ka ọ dị okike karịa, ya mere ọ ziri ezi

l-e-e5-b03-33.s.s1.r.c: its na-egosi ịbụ nwe ihe n'enweghị apostrophe. it's pụtara it is.

l-e-e5-b04-31.material: My dog is bigger ___ my cat. A: Jiri then. Ụda ha yiri, ya mere ihe ọ bụla ga-adị mma. B: Jiri than. Ọ bụ okwu e ji atụnyere.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke ka mma, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.o.a: A: Ụda ha yiri, ya mere then nwekwara ike ịrụ ọrụ
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.r.a: then pụtara “n’oge ahụ”, ya mere a gaghị eji ya atụnyere.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Jiri than mgbe a na-atụnyere
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.r.c: then na than nwere ihe dị iche iche ha pụtara; ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.r.d: B, nke jiri than, ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s1.explain: Mgbe comparative gasịrị, jiri than. then pụtara “n’oge ahụ” ma ọ bụ “mgbe ahụ”.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ ntụnyere mgbe bigger gasịrị; ya mere B nke jiri than bụ azịza ziri ezi.
l-e-e5-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: then na-egosi oge, ya mere jiri than n’ahịrịokwu ntụnyere.

l-e-e5-b04-34.title: Tụnyere nchịkọta abụọ nke ederede gbasara awọ
l-e-e5-b04-34.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta maka ahịrịokwu abụọ chịkọtara ederede, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e5-b04-34.material: Ederede: Mmiri ozuzo jupụtara n’ọdọ mmiri. Awọ tọrọ àkwá n’ebe ahụ. N’oge na-adịghị anya, ọtụtụ tadpole na-egwu mmiri n’ime ya. Nchịkọta A: Awọ na-ebi n’ọdọ mmiri. Nchịkọta B: Mgbe mmiri ozuzo jupụtara n’ọdọ mmiri, awọ tọrọ àkwá, tadpole pụtakwara.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nchịkọta ka mma, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ dị mkpirikpi, ya mere ọ chịkọtara ederede nke ọma
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mkpirikpi, ma akụkọ banyere mmiri ozuzo, àkwá na tadpole adịghị.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.o.b: B: O nwere usoro ihe ndị mere n’ederede ahụ n’enweghị ịhapụ ihe ọ bụla
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.r.c: A hapụrụ usoro ihe ndị mere.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.r.d: Ha abụọ metụtara ederede ahụ. Ihe dị iche bụ ole ha gụnyere.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta dị mma na-agụnye ihe ndị dị mkpa n’ederede ahụ n’usoro. B gụnyere mmiri ozuzo, àkwá na tadpole.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: B gụnyere usoro mmiri ozuzo, àkwá na tadpole niile, ya mere ọ ka A mma.
l-e-e5-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: A kwuru naanị na awọ na-ebi n’ọdọ mmiri; ya mere ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ịgụnye ọdịnaya ederede ahụ.
